name: survarium::game::assign_music_emitter
evidence: Descriptive name: retains the resource in the selected music slot, stops/releases its old proxy, then calls play_music with 2000 ms and looping enabled; loading callback 0x20014bb60 selects slot 2.

name: survarium::game::play_music
evidence: Qualified diagnostic at 0x200956030; six slots; fades other playing proxies out over 2000 ms; selected slot receives duration and looping arguments; out-of-range track stops all slots.

name: survarium::loading_screen::on_music_loaded
evidence: Descriptive name: async callback installed at 0x20011b839 for mode/ui/loading_music; forwards the loaded single-sound resource to game::assign_music_emitter with slot 2.

name: vostok::sound::sound_instance_proxy::fade_out
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009d7ae0 slot 4, queues duration and proxy to 0x200623400, which converts milliseconds to samples and enters propagator state 5.

name: survarium::weapon_core_cook::query_weapon_states
evidence: Descriptive name: reads parameters/reload_time, then tactical_reload_time (default reload_time), reload_start_time, reload_end_time, tactical_reload_start_time, tactical_reload_end_time (each defaulting as 0x20038421E..0x20038435A) into the 68h weapon_state_creation_params (+24h reload, +28h tactical, +2Ch start, +30h tactical start, +34h end, +38h tactical end; 0x2003847E2..0x200384838).

name: survarium::pistol_weapon_core_reload_state::pistol_weapon_core_reload_state
evidence: Descriptive name: stores vtable 0x2009980F8 (RTTI .?AVpistol_weapon_core_reload_state@survarium@@); base ctor 0x20038E9B0 with params+24h (reload_time); keeps params+28h (tactical_reload_time) at +2E4h; the two item clips at +2C0h.

name: survarium::pistol_weapon_core_reload_state::initialize
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009980F8 slot 1; after the base initialize 0x20038EA70, latches [weapon+44BAh] == 0 (the magazine empty) at +2E0h and picks the item clip +2C0h + 8 x it.

name: survarium::pistol_weapon_core_reload_state::serialize
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009980F8 slot 4; the base's, then one byte, +2E0h (the latched magazine state).

name: survarium::pistol_weapon_core_reload_state::deserialize
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009980F8 slot 5; reads the base's flag (+268h), then +2E0h.

name: survarium::pistol_weapon_core_reload_state::get_user_hands_expression
evidence: Descriptive name: vtable 0x2009980F8 slot 9; +2E0h 0 (rounds left): time +2E4h (tactical_reload_time), clip +2D8h; else time +26Ch (reload_time), clip +2D0h; the time through the player's reload modifier (0x20031E1E0, index 0Bh), speed = clip length (+1F4h) / 30 / time.

name: survarium::weapon_core_reload_state::weapon_core_reload_state
evidence: Descriptive name: stores vtable 0x200997838 (RTTI .?AVweapon_core_reload_state@survarium@@); reads params+24h (reload_time) only: a one-clip reload has no tactical time.

name: survarium::weapon_core_reload_state_base::initialize
evidence: Descriptive name: with [weapon+44CFh] (chamber_a_round_on_reload) and [weapon+44CDh] (a round chambered), unload_chambered_round 0x2006D8E60 (the round back into the magazine); no tactical +1.

name: survarium::weapon_core::load_magazine
evidence: Descriptive name: loads min(ammo, [+44B9h] capacity - [+44BAh] in magazine) into the magazine, then chambers a round with chamber_a_round_on_reload (+44CFh).

name: survarium::weapon_core_shotgun_reload_base_substate::weapon_core_shotgun_reload_base_substate
evidence: Descriptive name: a shotgun substate's base ctor with two times, XMM2 the normal (+2B8h) and XMM3 the tactical (+2B4h); start 0x20038FC00 passes reload_start_time / tactical_reload_start_time, one round 0x20038FE50 reload_time / tactical_reload_time; the lexeme 0x200395557 takes [+2B4h + 4 x index].
